p: Wright will start at right guard with Ruiz moving to center.
He fills the right guard spot in the reshuffled line.
Wright stepped in on the offensive line for his first extended playing time and made his first start, and did well enough to keep contributing.
A rookie lineman performing well in a fill-in role helps the offensive line and the run game, and could matter if injuries continue up front.
thought that was a good, good first start for him.
